entities.name: José Villanueva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis "Cely" Villanueva was an amateur boxer from the Philippines who represented his country at the 1932 Los Angeles Olympics. Born in Binondo, Manila, he won the bronze medal in the bantamweight class after winning the fight for third place against Joseph Lang.
